# Sapporo Travel

> > Official tourism guide for Sapporo, Hokkaido, featuring local cuisine, seasonal events, and travel information for Japan's northern city.

Sapporo Travel is the official tourism website operated by the Sapporo Tourism Association, providing comprehensive guides to the city's famous food scene (miso ramen, sushi, seafood), major events like the Sapporo Snow Festival, and attractions throughout Hokkaido's capital city.

## Key Topics

- Sapporo (札幌)
- Hokkaido (北海道)
- Sapporo Snow Festival (さっぽろ雪まつり)
- Miso Ramen
- Hokkaido Sushi & Seafood
- Susukino (すすきの)
- Local Cuisine
- Sapporo Central Wholesale Market (札幌市中央卸売市場)
- Nijo Market (札幌二条市場)
- Sapporo Clock Tower (札幌市時計台)
- Sapporo Gourmet Coupon (さっぽろグルメクーポン)
- Seasonal Fish
- Restaurant Recommendations
- Sapporo Tourism Association (札幌観光協会)

## Food & Dining Guides

- [Sapporo Sushi Guide: Eating Tips & Popular Restaurants](https://www.sapporo.travel/gourmet/feature/eating-sushi-and-making-sushi): Sapporo sushi guide: eating tips & popular restaurants in Hokkaido
- [Sapporo Miso Ramen Feature](https://www.sapporo.travel/gourmet/feature/miso-ramen): Sapporo miso ramen feature: birthplace guide to local ramen shops

## Events & Festivals

- [73rd Sapporo Snow Festival Announcement](https://www.sapporo.travel/news/sapporo-snowfestival2023): 73rd Sapporo Snow Festival announcement: Odori & Susukino venues
